classes.note: first rule that fits wins; decisions are proposals for Datum and Latch

list.title: Rounded corners: StreamCorner arcs against the plan's square block corners
list.why: Built-only arcs at 1.6 m and plan-only corners at 2.3 m are one geometry: the old 8 × 8 corner cell rounds every outside corner (Sky asked for these corners). Proposal: a plan standard for the outside-corner radius of perimeter blocks; the matcher rounds the plan's outside corners by it before comparing.

list.title: Old ground on the Handover's kept streets and plots
list.why: The plan keeps these roads and plots byte for byte (KEEP_ROADS / KEEP_PLOTS; protected by the brief). The swap cut removes standing pieces and flat old ground under 30 m there, but old kerb stones, flags and city mass remain or our masses are not stood in. Proposal: the cut takes kerb stones, flag modules and city mass too, and the kept plots carry the export's masses (as the zone does).

list.title: Old flag modules on plan plot ground (yards, forecourts, the Southside plots)
list.why: A plan plot runs from the kerb (Datum, first round): flags laid on plot ground are paving inside the plot, not a pavement edge out of place. Proposal: the matcher counts built flags inside a plan plot as plot paving; only flags off every plot and off the plan pavements fail.

list.title: Doors against old bay fronts
list.why: Doors are no plan field outside the civic block (Datum, first round: 26 ops rejected); our frontage generator places them per bay class and the old builders model bays, not doors (in the west the SwapWest blocks lay their bays on the old module, so ours and theirs fall apart there too). Proposal: outside the Handover zone report these as information, not failures.

list.title: Southside ground (the 35° courses, Apollo Way, Market Street)
list.owner: Latch (E10 follow-up) · Datum for any street the plan should take
list.why: Kerbs and flags of the old Southside layout that E10 moved onto the plan blocks still run on the old lines in places (diagonal kerb runs on Market Street and Apollo Way, plan pavement edges with no old flag). Market Street is not a kept Handover street, so where the old line is the better street Datum may take it instead.

list.title: Kerb lines off the plan's road edges
list.owner: Datum (per road: plan takes the old line, or rejects with a reason)
list.why: Old kerb runs the plan does not have (Crown Avenue past the circus, the Boulevard's far south) and plan kerbs with no old stone within 0.5 m; each is a road width or line call.

list.title: Megastructure podiums (Lantern and Crown Terraces) against old frontage runs
list.why: Old runs stand where the plan has a megastructure podium; Datum rejected RL2/RB1 in lantern-court on the same ground in the first round.

list.title: Other footprints
list.why: Block and plot edges that differ by more than the corner rounding: the plan-patch ops.

list.title: Landmarks and flagships: old piece outline against the plan reservation
list.why: Plan landmarks are reservations (centre + r) and the old pieces stand at those centres; their foot outlines (legs, docks, podiums) are not a plot edge. Datum rejected the same class before ("a landmark, not a plot", 13 ops). Proposal: compare landmarks by centre and containment, not edge to edge.

list.title: SpaceHQ: the scene is "ours", the plan is "old"
list.owner: Datum (plan form ours) · Splice (bank ground in the drum, done in this round)
list.why: Swap2 builds our SpaceHQ_Portal (Sky's pick) while plan 0.5.5 keeps form "old"; the old HQ's ground has no built piece. Clears when `transcribe --spacehq ours` passes and becomes the plan.

run joins: two runs' end bays meeting at a block corner, the shopfront and canopy depth (≤ 3.1 m) crossing
